local pg=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui
local h=pg:FindFirstChild("CornMinimapHud")
local f=pg:FindFirstChild("MinimapAcceptance")
local out={snapshot=f and f:GetAttributes(),ui={}}
if h then
 out.enabled=h.Enabled
 for _,i in h:GetDescendants() do
  if i:IsA("GuiObject") and (i.Name=="Expanded" or i.Name=="Compact" or i.Name=="PlayerArrow" or i.Name=="Player" or string.find(i.Name,"Visit") or string.find(i.Name,"Death") or i.Name=="Close") then
   table.insert(out.ui,{path=i:GetFullName(),visible=i.Visible,position={i.Position.X.Scale,i.Position.X.Offset,i.Position.Y.Scale,i.Position.Y.Offset},rotation=i.Rotation,size={i.AbsoluteSize.X,i.AbsoluteSize.Y},modal=i:IsA("GuiButton") and i.Modal})
  end
 end
end
out.mouse=tostring(game.UserInputService.MouseBehavior)
out.camera=tostring(game.Players.LocalPlayer.CameraMode)
return game.HttpService:JSONEncode(out)
